> 小畜。亨。密雲不雨，自我西郊。

The name of hexagram nine is usually read as "small accumulation." Two thousand years of glosses support that. The problem is a technical one inside the character.

## 畜 is a captured animal

說文: 畜，田畜也。《淮南子》曰：玄田為畜 — animals taken in the hunt and kept, domestic stock.

Accumulation proper is written 蓄 (說文 蓄，積也). In the classics the two characters are used interchangeably, which is why 小畜 is read as 小蓄.

But there is a layer most commentaries do not separate out.

畜 carries two glosses in the 易: 蓄積, to store and nourish; and 畜止, to stop, to restrain.

Wang Bi and Cheng Yi take "stop." Zheng Xuan takes "nourish."

And in this hexagram the two are not in conflict. They are one mechanism: only what can be held back accumulates.

風把雲攏住，雲才積得厚 — the wind gathers the clouds, and the gathering is what makes them thick. Stopping is the hand of accumulating.

Which means "small accumulation" is being done by restraint, and the hexagram is about a restraint that is too small to become rain.

## 密雲不雨，自我西郊

Dense cloud, no rain, from my western suburb.

The old glosses note the geography: 西郊，陰所也 (Wang Bi) — west is the yin quarter.

Yin has moved first and the yang does not answer. So there is cloud and no rain.

不是沒雲，是配合不上. Not the absence of cloud. The failure of the match.

That is a much more precise diagnosis than "the time is not ripe," and it is the sentence the whole hexagram turns on: the material is all present and the two sides are not in phase.

## 輿說輻

九三 輿說輻，夫妻反目.

說 is 脫 (same usage as 蒙's 用說桎梏).

輻 are the spokes between rim and hub — not the axle fitting, which is 輹, an alternative reading in other editions (this book follows the received text).

One spoke comes out, the wheel goes out of true, and the cart cannot move.

And the precision of the image is exactly the line it is paired with: 夫妻反目. Not torn apart. Off true. The wheel is still a wheel; it is running at an angle.

## 攣如

有孚攣如，富以其鄰.

說文: 攣，系也 — bound, tied.

So the fifth line's trust is trust that is tied together — and the character carries its own warning, because 攣 is not "holding hands." It is "tethered."

Trust that binds is real, and it can also become the thing that cannot be untied.

## 月幾望

說文: 望，月滿也. 幾望 is approaching the full moon — nearly full, not yet.

Which is the critical point of the hexagram: one step further and the fullness begins to decline.

小畜's whole position is this: the accumulation has arrived at the edge of sufficiency, and the remaining question is whether the last increment would complete it or begin to undo it.

## A test

Take something you are holding back — a launch, a raise, an announcement. Ask whether the holding is accumulating (the clouds thickening) or merely stopping (the clouds sitting still). The hexagram says these are the same verb, and the difference is whether anything inside is building.
